# omnibias documentation

> Numerically-stable closed-form n-th derivative forward-pass framework.
> This is the documentation site map for LLMs. omnibias computes
> `sigma^(n)(z)` in closed form for arbitrary `n`, bit-identical across
> PyTorch, JAX, and Keras 3.

- [Closed-form derivatives](theory.md)
- [Activation dictionary](activations.md)

- [Roadmap](roadmap.md)
- [PINN derivations](pinn-derivations.md)
